basis.title: Handbook for Optimised Deprival Valuation of System Fixed Assets of Electricity Lines Businesses, 30 August 2004
basis.label: DISTRIBUTION TRANSFORMERS – Ground Mounted, Single/Two Phase, 22/0.4 and 11/0.4 kV, Cable Entry – 22/0.4 kV, 100 kVA to 1,500 kVA
basis.note: Printed page 35. Ground-mounted (pad-type) distribution transformers of an electricity network, oil-filled in NZ practice; all eight sizes 100-1,500 kVA have Standard Life 45 years. Heading printed as 'Single/Two Phase'. Utility network assets (2004). Regulatory valuation for electricity lines businesses, superseded as a valuation method by the Commerce Commission's Input Methodologies (from 2010). Only the ground-mounted distribution transformer rows map to a library component.

basis.title: Design standards: employer's requirements – Technical Manual (ER-DFE-XX-XX-T-X-0201, revision A-C01)
basis.label: High voltage (HV) switchgear, transformers and packaged substations: 35 years
basis.note: Printed page 275. HV transformers on a school site (packaged substations); type not stated. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Distribution Transformers (final rule), 89 FR 29834, April 22, 2024
basis.by: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
basis.label: Transformer Service Lifetime: "a distribution of lifetimes, with an estimated average of 32 years and a maximum of 60 years"
basis.note: Printed page 29946. Covers all distribution transformers, including low-voltage dry-type (building dry-type) and medium-voltage liquid-immersed (pad-mounted). Mean of a distribution; the maximum is 60 years. Same value also stated on p.5 (printed 29838) and in Table IV summary on p.101 (printed 29934).

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Transformers
basis.note: Printed page 34. Power generation and electrical reticulation category; type not stated. Also 'Transformers 25' under ELEC p.15. Printed DV 8%, SL 6%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
Some maintenance intervals come from TM 5-692-1, an Army manual for mission-critical (C4ISR) facilities; they may be tighter than typical commercial practice.
